shared_elements: standing human figure in strict profile
figure holding an object in an extended hand
stylized tree/palmette with repeated leaf or frond units
low-relief single-register composition with figures aligned on a groundline
patterned fringed garment with detailed hem
detailed rendering of hair/beard and musculature of arms and legs
justification: Both show profile human figures in fringed garments carrying objects, striding on a groundline in a single relief register, with a conventionalized tree of stacked leaf/frond units placed at the edge of the field toward which the figures are oriented, and both render anatomy, hair and drapery hems with the same detailed, half-naturalistic conventions. The main differences in content are that A's protagonist is a large winged, bird-headed composite being holding a bucket and cone before the tree, while B shows a multi-figure procession with a large camel and encloses the scene between horizontal rosette borders.
